name: MagnetLines-TS-TW
blurb: Grid of short lines that rotate toward the cursor in real-time.
description: A CSS Grid of lines that track pointer position and rotate individually to face the cursor, creating a rippling field effect.
use_when: Abstract, technical backgrounds or hero sections where a subtle pointer-responsive pattern fits.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces — pointer tracking is the core interaction and does not scale well to touch.
a11y: Passive visual effect; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
